## Où j'en suis
The PostgreSQL 17 upgrade for the analytics RDS is written and verified plan-only on staging: the parameter group family is now derived from the major version, blue/green is enabled on `analytics-staging` (16.4 → 17.2), the AWS provider is pinned to `~> 5.82.0`, and prod is prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false` with an empty plan. Three commits on `noa/rds-pg17`, and draft PR #57 is open with the pg_partman and dbt-lock caveats in its description; nothing was applied anywhere.

- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 → 5.1.0 on staging 16.4 and check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw`/`events_daily` before the switchover, or green won't even be created.
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya's sign-off, then pick the prod window outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock (Saturday or Sunday 04:00–06:00 UTC are the candidates).
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` refused the 5.31.0 lock file; `init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6 and produced 37 unrelated breaking changes, so it was reverted.
- [décision] AWS provider stays `~> 5.82.0`, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] The pg_partman upgrade is a separate todo, nothing run against the database (source: t10)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; `apply_immediately` stays false and 02:00 UTC is out because of the dbt lock (source: t14)
